column1: Role and property are always visible
column2: The header reads "Genie · Front desk · Harbor View". Users never wonder whose permissions or which hotel an answer reflects.
Every figure comes from a PMS API and is composed server-side. The model phrases; it does not calculate. A wrong ADR is worse than no ADR.
If Genie cannot do something (Phase 1 actions, unsupported requests) it says so in one line and offers the fastest alternative. No silent failures, no raw errors.
Phase 1's superpower: "book a deluxe Fri–Sun" opens New Reservation with dates and room type filled. Most of the value of an action with none of the risk.
Every guide answer names the help section or policy it came from so staff can verify and learn - Genie doubles as training.
A denied request returns no data, no hints, and names who can help. Denials are analytics events, not audit events.
Genie sends IDs and aggregates to the model, not records. Guest names are tokenised before the model call and re-hydrated only in the rendered card. Housekeeping lists show rooms, not names.
A typed card number is masked client-side and refused; payments run only on the tokenised terminal flow.
One /api/genie contract serves the web panel, ⌘K bar and mobile sheet. Surface is a presentation decision, not an architectural one.
Offline or model-unavailable, the on-device intent engine still navigates and renders cached cards. Never "service unavailable".
